name: desktop-defaults
description: /usr/bin/desktop-defaults (Lane D, source-lib design §6.2): the additive default-Desktop reconcile — re-plant missing entries from the baked /usr/share/desktop/default rendering (fileops.h fo_copy, recursive folder merge, never overwrite/delete), then re-plant missing icons for installed desktop-eligible packages (control.json desktop.cmd, recorded into the gucman DB so remove unplants).
